protocol.name: lumatv_subtitles_v1
protocol.description: An optional private hint for the painted subtitle area of a client surface. Bounds use the stated canvas coordinates and take effect on wl_surface.commit. A 0 by 0 rectangle reports that no subtitles are painted; until a report is committed, or after a region is destroyed or its surface unmapped, the bounds are unknown.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: surface does not belong to the client

entry.name: duplicate_region
entry.summary: surface already has a subtitle region

request.name: set_bounds

description.summary: set the pending painted subtitle bounds

request.description: Canvas dimensions must be positive and at most 16384. The rectangle must fit within the canvas; width and height are both positive or both zero. A zero-sized rectangle denotes known empty subtitle content.
